en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a view of a city street lined with historical European buildings, trees, and people walking along the sidewalk. Horse-drawn carriages or trams are present, and the scene extends into the distance with hills in the background. The street is identified as Jakominigasse. There is handwritten text on the postcard, and the printed caption at the top in red reads 'Graz - Jakominigasse.' Additional handwritten notes are present both at the top and over the photograph.
